task_instance: Built a synthetic NV-Generate-style medical inference evidence pack (runs/inference_pack/{manifest.json,result.json} with model/checkpoint/seed/recipe_hash/prompt/metrics, plus a sanitized config file) and a script implementing the SKILL.md-documented contract for scripts/export_evidence_pack.py. Ran it in default dry-run mode to inspect the params/metrics/artifact_plan/mlflow.note.content export_result contract, then ran it in --mode local with --artifact-policy metadata to actually log the run (params, metrics, and mlflow.note.content note) into a local MLflow tracking store (sqlite:///mlruns.db), and independently read the logged run back via the MLflow tracking client to confirm the data round-tripped correctly.

Created sample evidence pack at runs/inference_pack/{manifest.json,result.json} and configs/chest_lung_tumor.json. Implemented scripts/export_evidence_pack.py (dry-run prints the params/metrics/artifact_plan/mlflow.note.content contract; local/databricks modes log to MLflow via mlflow.start_run()+log_param/log_metric/set_tag). Installed mlflow 3.16.1 and numpy 2.4.6 into a local venv (pip install "mlflow>=2.10,<4" "numpy>=1.24,<3"). Ran `python scripts/export_evidence_pack.py runs/inference_pack --mode dry-run --artifact-policy metadata` and got the expected JSON contract (params incl. model/checkpoint/seed/recipe_hash/source_ref/prompt_digest, metrics, artifact_plan.policy=metadata with no files, mlflow.note.content summary). Ran `python scripts/export_evidence_pack.py runs/inference_pack --mode local --experiment-name medical-ai-inference --config configs/chest_lung_tumor.json --seed 0 --source-ref git:61c4ec... ` (MLflow's legacy ./mlruns file store is deprecated in mlflow 3.x, so the script uses tracking_uri sqlite:///mlruns.db) -> produced local_export_result.json with status=exported, a real run_id, and the tracking_uri; mlruns.db (876KB sqlite file) was created. Verified by a separate Python snippet using mlflow.tracking.MlflowClient().search_runs() against the same sqlite store, which returned the logged run with matching params (model, checkpoint, seed, recipe_hash, source_ref, config_digest, prompt_digest), matching metrics (mask_foreground_pct=3.42, tumor_volume_pct=1.87), and the mlflow.note.content tag text -- confirming the evidence pack was actually mirrored into MLflow, not just simulated. No MCP/connector tools, no network calls beyond pip install, no credentials used, all work confined to the work directory.
